scope.order: registered before any processing (design factors only)

attempts_plan.C: 1140 x 3 front ends + 3 x 3 counterexample (its sigma-0 reference: label extraction only)
attempts_plan.B: <= 24 decode attempts on stored C images (adapter / reference / recovery checks)

definition.geometry_phase: N0..N7 geometric position of the pattern (u, v for dots; phase_frac for lines), unchanged from S3-CODE-03
definition.code_parity: class placement: 0 = old placement, 1 = classes swapped; N0/N2/N4/N6 -> 0, N1/N3/N5/N7 -> 1 for every surface, layout, sigma and level; weak / mid / strong share the placement of a block; plain patterns have no parity (always 0) and are stored once
definition.implementation: integer-pitch shift in the new adapter c4_parity.py: dots u + 1 pitch, lines phase_frac + 1 pitch (line ids shift by -1); class 1 = large dot / wide line in both parities; parity 0 = old generator call (checked array by array)
definition.limitation: balanced placement sample (4 blocks per placement); no estimate of the class-swap effect at fixed geometry; not an exhaustive code-phase coverage

checks.first_run_superseded: semantic width check without clipping exclusion; 6 line configurations flagged by a border-cut wide line

manifest.sigma_correlation: sigma levels of one block share the base noise field (S3-CODE-03 seeds unchanged): repetitions across sigma are not independent

gate.expected_keys: manifest x frozen method table x frozen fingerprints (decode / eval / diag); only expected keys are read; other versions and unplanned records are reported, never counted
gate.formal_structure: 8 geometry phases per stratum, sigma 0 once and sigma > 0 twice per phase, one position per phase label and one label per position, 4 patterns per pair key with one seed, every rule / arm / diagnostic arm
gate.records: missing / slot identity (image, rule, arm) / duplicates / metric missing with output / accepted count missing -> formal statistics refused; progress mode marked PARTIAL
gate.no_output: scientific no-output (no accepted point): C_tau 0, RMSE / P95 undefined, counted in the denominator; never a technical stop
gate.references: decode references verify source npz AND source json hashes

metrics.coverage: global and local C_valid, C_tau, gap = C_valid - C_tau (supported = interpolable and support measure <= d 6 mm; accurate = supported and |err| <= tau 0.15 mm)
metrics.accuracy: point RMSE / P95, registered surface RMSE / P95, each with its own valid denominator
metrics.identity_shares: main w/(c+w); lower bound of all accepted w/(c+w+u); upper bound (w+u)/(c+w+u); incremental on the newly accepted set; zero denominators undefined
metrics.thresholds: 0.1 % main wrong-id gate, 0.05 % / 0.5 % sensitivity, unconfirmable rule unchanged; strict identity pass != task success; no-output never passes
metrics.aggregation: per surface, layout, level, sigma, front end; repetitions averaged inside a phase, then phases equally weighted; no pooling over surfaces

effects.E1: same image, same front end: use code - ignore code
effects.E2: coded pattern - plain pattern (scheme difference incl. size-dependent front end; not a pure code-information effect)
effects.E3: front-end difference DF / DS / B0 on the same image

attribution.statement: R5x4 DF sigma 0 -> 40: C_tau -32.32 pp, C_valid -2.00 pp, gap +30.32 pp; an arithmetic split of the metric, not a causal allocation to detection, localization or interpolation

diagnostics.TC_src: conditional diagnostic, same front end, correct-class condition; own denominator
diagnostics.TI_src: excludes unconfirmable components; not a monotone upper bound of every metric (e.g. R5x4 DF sigma 100: TI C_tau 0.033 < method 0.104)

B_analysis.bootstrap: future 8-block descriptive resampling: 4 blocks drawn within each parity layer, the same index for all paired arms of a block, no fictitious dot / line pairing; the 2 C phases are reported per phase with ranges only
